Home.heading: Performance reviews
Home.welcome: What the semester reviews say, in one place: completion, retention, engagement and what people write.

descriptions.executive: Completion, retention, engagement, risk and sentiment of the cycle in a single view.
descriptions.completion: Who sent their self-assessment and their manager review, and who is missing.
descriptions.indicators: Alerts, distribution and trend of retention and engagement across cycles.
descriptions.qualitative: Sentiment and themes of the comments, by dimension, department and cycle.
descriptions.selfAssessment: Sentiment of the self-assessments and the gap against the manager review.
descriptions.dm360: One card per DM (delivery manager) with the people in their care for the cycle.
descriptions.engagement: Engagement score, participation and segments month by month.
descriptions.upload: Upload a Bamboo report or a data lake table.
descriptions.imports: Import runs, their outcome and the history.
descriptions.identity: Records that could not be matched to a person automatically.
descriptions.dataQuality: Cases to fix before analysing or reporting.
descriptions.insightsSettings: Alert thresholds, minimum group size, semester cuts and analysis provider.
descriptions.goalsArea: Each person's goals: progress, milestones, due dates and comments, filtered by cycle, status and team.
descriptions.assessmentsArea: The questions and answers of each cycle: self-assessment and manager review, next to the goals of the period.
descriptions.goalsInsights: Goal completion next to each person's retention and engagement.

InsightsSettings.title: Insights settings
InsightsSettings.description: Alert thresholds, minimum group size, semester cuts, monthly engagement cutoffs and analysis provider. Only People can change them and every change goes to the audit log.

Upload.title: Upload a file
Upload.description: Import a report exported from Bamboo or a table from your data lake. Rows are stored exactly as they come; mapping them to people, assessments or goals is a later step.

choose.title: Choose a file
choose.hint: CSV, XLSX, Parquet or NDJSON, up to {max} MB.
choose.empty: Choose a file to see its columns and first rows before importing.

preview.title: Preview
preview.existed: This exact content was uploaded before: the stored file is reused.
preview.matches: The file has every column the profile needs.
preview.noRows: The file has no data rows.
preview.blocked: Fix the profile problems to be able to import.
preview.historyHint: The rows become historical review cycles, with their participants, requests and answers.
preview.landingHint: The rows are kept as they are (raw), without creating cycles.
preview.orgHint: Rows are imported as each person's organizational attributes (account, project, DM and Santex Lead, with their validity) by EEID; EEIDs that match nobody wait in the identity queue.
preview.partialFile: Partial file (do not drop what the file does not list)
preview.partialHint: Only the attributes in the file are added and updated; whatever the file does not mention is kept.
preview.completeHint: The file is the whole list: attributes of this source that it no longer lists are dropped (only for the columns it has).
preview.engagementHint: Rows are imported as each person's monthly engagement (a 0-1 score and a segment per month) by EEID; if the file has no segment it is derived with the cutoffs of the insights settings, and EEIDs that match nobody wait in the identity queue. A file adds and corrects months, it never deletes the ones it does not list.
